description: This file is a Java source code for an integration test class named ReportsTest, which tests various report-related functionalities of the Fineract system through API calls.

classes.name: ReportsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the /runreports/ API endpoints in the Fineract system, verifying report retrieval and execution behaviors.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured before each test case.

methods.name: listReports
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of reports and asserts the size of the returned list.

methods.name: runClientListingTableReport
methods.description: Tests executing a report and verifies the first column header is as expected.

methods.name: runClientListingTableReportCSV
methods.description: Runs a report and checks that the output content type is CSV and contains expected data.

methods.name: runReportCategory
methods.description: Uses raw OkHttp client to request report categories, verifying response status code.

methods.name: runExpectedPaymentsPentahoReportWithoutPlugin
methods.description: Tests that running a specific report without plugin returns a 503 error.

methods.name: runExpectedPaymentsPentahoReport
methods.description: Disabled test for running a specific report and verifying PDF content type.

methods.name: testTrialBalanceTableReportRunsSuccessfully
methods.description: Asserts successful execution of the Trial Balance Table report.

methods.name: testIncomeStatementTableReportRunsSuccessfully
methods.description: Asserts successful execution of the Income Statement Table report.

methods.name: testGeneralLedgerReportTableReportRunsSuccessfully
methods.description: Asserts successful execution of the General Ledger report.

methods.name: testBalanceSheetTableReportRunsSuccessfully
methods.description: Asserts successful execution of the Balance Sheet report.
